mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND r.status = 'ENABLED')

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND rp.permission_id=#{permissionId} AND r.status='ENABLED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id, organization_id, organization_scope_key) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{organizationId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{organizationScopeKey})
